note: MYTHOS host-operations allowlist — the DECLARED policy for what a Dagu host workflow may ask the root-owned helper (mythos-hostops) to do. Classes: READ (no approval), WRITE (governance approval), RESTART (governance approval), DEPLOY (owner approval), DESTRUCTIVE (never through this path). The helper validates every argument against the pattern here; an operation absent from this file is refused. Design record: docs/MYTHOS_DAGU_HOST_OPERATIONS.md §8.

WRITE.description: reversible change inside an allowlisted directory or a non-production container

RESTART.description: restart/reload of an allowlisted unit or container; never the governance, executor, OTHMODE or gateway units

DEPLOY.description: create or replace containers, networks, volumes from a pinned compose project

DESTRUCTIVE.description: irreversible; not executable through Dagu or the helper under any approval

denied_forever: any interactive or arbitrary shell as root
disabling governance-verify, the relay, or the executor's policy layer
restart of mythos-contextforge, mythos-ai-executor, mythos-command-center, mythos-git-push, mythos-mcp-http, docker.service
